order: Build the Quartermaster's deterministic P0 substrate: recorded allowance readings in, the router's bucket-state shape out. The module must have zero dependencies and must be CommonJS, mirroring the existing verifier and router substrates exactly. It must never fabricate a denominator — state may be derived only from real recorded readings, across both vendors — and ledger attribution must not be implemented here; it is impossible today and stays a registered follow-on only. allGreen() must remain exported as a test affordance and the router's wo7b score module must stay untouched. modelAssist must stay unused in this version — the substrate is deterministic only. No registry schema may be added; the entry contract belongs only in this module's own README. The two new runtime data files must be gitignored and never committed. Prove interop end to end against the real router and wire the new suite into CI directly after the router suite.
claims: We shipped a 914-line module and a 637-line test suite: 152 checks, all against temp-directory fixtures — the real project data files are never touched. Interop was proven against the live router: a green state dispatches end to end, a below-reserve reading fires the reserve gate, an unconfirmed arm fires and a recorded confirmation lifts it, a hard throttle takes the exhaustion recast, and an exhausted bucket forces mandatory review to not close. CI now runs the suite directly after the router's, and the two runtime files stay out of version control.
